text:
lina (product): quick sync request — we need a clean prioritization gate for inference perf work (latency vs throughput vs cost) to use in roadmap planning. suggestions?

jake (eng): +1. we keep patchy scorecards now. propose a 3-stage gate: impact eval, infra risk, customer delta.

sam (ml): to add — impact should be measured against concrete customer scenarios (avg seq len, qps distribution). numbers > not vague.

anya (sre): must include rollout safety: fallback paths, circuit breakers, throttles. otherwise we can't sign off.

lina (product): thinking RICE-ish but simplified: Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort -> convert to a single "priority" number. also need a separate economics check for per-token cost delta.

jake (eng): ok, rough formula: `priority = (reach * impact * confidence) / effort`

sam (ml): add a perf-econ delta calc: `delta_cost_per_1k_tokens = new_model_cost - baseline_cost` and treat large positive deltas as negative modifiers to priority.

lina (product): example gate checklist I'm drafting: 1) measurable latency improvement (p50/p95) OR throughput increase at target SLAs; 2) cost delta within tolerance or offset plan; 3) clear rollout + rollback; 4) customer benefit/use-case map.

tomas (pm): can we pick numeric thresholds? e.g., latency p95 improvement >= 15ms OR throughput +20% at same p95, cost delta <= 10% increase per 1k tokens unless offset by >x revenue/retention.

anya (sre): thresholds make ops happy. add: no single-point-failure introduced, and can disable feature per-route.

jake (eng): implementation note: measuring throughput must use realistic KV-cache hit patterns. microbench numbers deceive.

sam (ml): agree. we'll provide three eval inputs: 1) short chat (avg 64 tokens), 2) long completion (avg 512), 3) high-concurrency micro bursts. bench both latency and cost.

lina (product): product asks: for customer-driven asks (Acme, FinCorp) we should tag them as "contractual SLA" so they get precedence in scoring.

tomas (pm): assign weight: contractual_sla = +25% priority bump. community/unknown = 0.

jake (eng): quick poll: are we comfortable making cost delta a hard blocker if >25%? :thumbsup: yes, :thumbsdown: no

sam (ml): :thumbsup: — unless we can quantifiably show downstream revenue or retention lift that justifies spend.

anya (sre): :thumbsdown: — prefer a safety cap rather than a blanket block. maybe auto-rollback threshold at +30% cost.

lina (product): hmm ok new proposal: cost delta > 25% requires a compensating mitigation plan (quantized profile, caching, or selective routing). >40% auto-block unless exec signoff.

ops-bot: deployment-checklist reminder: please attach `perf/bench.yaml` and `rollout-plan.md` to the PR for Dedicated/Private deploys.

jake (eng): will draft `perf/bench.yaml` with the three scenarios Sam listed. sharing by EOD.

sam (ml): i'll produce baseline numbers and a small eval harness (1000 sample prompts) so product can sanity check impact claims.

lina (product): next steps: Jake + Sam to deliver bench artifacts, Anya to specify rollout requirements, Tomas and I will codify the scoring worksheet by Fri. if done earlier we'll slot into next roadmap grooming.

anya (sre): noted. I'll write a short SLO-Rollback appendix.

tomas (pm): FYI I'll prep a short note for sales about how SLA customers are prioritized in the gate.

lina (product): thanks — this will keep roadmap debates concrete. tagging @jake @sam @anya for follow-ups. :pray:

jake (eng): got it.

sam (ml): on it.

-- end of thread --
